overrides._comment: Add fixed quiz questions here keyed by session title. If a key matches the session title, these questions are used instead of AI-generated ones. Each question needs: id, question, objective.

Understanding Profit Drivers.question: In your own words, what is the 'gap' concept in the Scaffolding Revenue Model and why does it matter to an advisor?
Understanding Profit Drivers.objective: Understand the gap between owner assumptions and actual financial performance

Understanding Profit Drivers.question: Describe the Trial Fit Method in two or three sentences — what is the tailored suit metaphor and what does it achieve?
Understanding Profit Drivers.objective: Explain the Trial Fit delivery approach

Understanding Profit Drivers.question: Why would an advisor choose the Cautious Reveal method over the Trial Fit method? What client situation calls for it?
Understanding Profit Drivers.objective: Distinguish between the two delivery methods based on client awareness
